title: Why Do We Yawn? The Brain-Cooling Mystery!

lines.text: Bet you can't watch this entire video without yawning once!
lines.caps: Bet you can't watch this *ENTIRE | video without *YAWNING once!

lines.text: Your mouth opens super wide and you take in a giant gulp of air!
lines.caps: Your mouth opens *SUPER wide | and you take in a *GIANT | gulp of *AIR!

lines.text: Are you just bored? No way! Your brain is an active supercomputer!
lines.caps: Are you just *BORED? | No way! Your brain is an *ACTIVE | *SUPERCOMPUTER!

lines.text: When your brain works hard thinking and playing, it heats up like a phone!
lines.caps: When your brain works *HARD, | it heats up like a *PHONE | playing *GAMES!

lines.text: A big yawn acts like a cooling fan, pumping fresh cool air inside!
lines.caps: A big yawn acts like a *COOLING | fan, pumping *FRESH | cool air *INSIDE!

lines.text: It cools your blood vessels and resets your energy levels instantly!
lines.caps: It cools your *BLOOD | vessels and resets your *ENERGY | *INSTANTLY!

lines.text: And when friends yawn together, your mirror neurons show you share feelings!
lines.caps: And when friends yawn *TOGETHER, | your mirror neurons show *YOU | share *FEELINGS!

lines.text: Your body has superpowers you use every single day without knowing!
lines.caps: Your body has *SUPERPOWERS | you use every *SINGLE | day without *KNOWING!
